name: Cnvrse
author: cnvrse

sections.description:
Cnvrse Lite adds a fully functional live chat system to your WordPress site in minutes.

Main Features

  • Lightweight and easy to install
  • Reply from your WordPress Admin interface
  • Optional Telegram sync for remote replies
  • Customize chat widget color and greeting text
  • Fully compatible with WordPress block and classic themes
  • Runs in under two minutes from setup to first message

Built with native WordPress technologies for maximum compatibility and performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cnvrse-lite/ or install through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Cnvrse Lite to configure your chat widget.
  4. Customize your chat color and greeting message.
  5. (Optional) Add your Telegram Bot Token to sync chats with your Telegram app.

You are now ready to chat with your visitors directly from your WordPress Admin or Telegram.
sections.faq:
Does it work without Telegram?

Yes. You can reply to visitors directly from your WordPress Admin.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The widget is lightweight and loads asynchronously.
